notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q3408831_conshelf_ii.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/placekit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. On the reef plateau of Sha'ab Rumi, off Port Sudan, at about 10 m: what Cousteau's team left in 1963 — the domed hangar of the diving saucer on its legs, with the air pocket under it, the tool shed and two fish pens — with the reef rock beside them. The Starfish House and the deep cabin were taken away. The layout and the heading (not published here: 0) are approximate. model_built.glb: the station in 1963, with the Starfish House. No marine life in the model (in the sea they are covered in coral): Offlined draws the living things itself. Rebuilt 2026-11: the hangar's meridian ribs, a row of round portholes round its shoulder, the lip of its rim, the top hatch, braced legs on ballast feet and the saucer's cradle inside; the tool shed on skids with its door and window; model_built.glb adds the diving saucer SP-350 on its cradle and round portholes on the Starfish House.
